'''March 2001 Knoxville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Knoxville Gaming Bureau (KGB), Knoxville, TN on 4 March 2001. [[Grady Hutchins]] won it. It is known from Joseph Hennessey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1844">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-4-mar-2001-knoxville-gaming-bureau-kgbd1844/ 4-mar-2001-knoxville-gaming-bureau-kgb], DeckTech (Joseph "bluehead" Hennessey, 5 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-4-mar-2001-knoxville-gaming-bureau-kgbd1844/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Knoxville Gaming Bureau (KGB), Knoxville, TN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Grady Hutchins]]
